reviewStandard: Only exact neutral indole-3-carbinol and current exact Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG strain morphology are cleared for one immutable call each. The other four routes fail material, formulation, protocol, source, population, measurement, safety, or causal-interpretation gates and receive no prompt marker or generation call.
promotionRule: Only literal outputs matching the frozen 11-heavy-atom I3C graph or eight-body, six-grouping LGG morphology requirements may proceed to exact-hash review. The other four routes remain non-public scientific holds.
